name: Kujou Koori
source:
[url=/c1344]Natsuki[/url]'s childhood friend. Attended the same school and later, college. 

Refreshing, unhesitating and accurate, doesn't like others that make mistakes. Her personality changes when she is with  [url=/c1344]Natsuki[/url]. Is attracted to him but still can't confess.
